The '''15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet''' was a unit in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].

==History==
[[Kentor Sarne]] served with this reserve [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] aboard the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[FarStar|''Renegade'']]. [[Malfkla Yzu]] served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the fleet.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the fleet conducted customs patrols around [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], to combat [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] in the region. Additionally, the fleet had established a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] interdiction checkpoint along the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] to prevent [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|unauthorized access]] to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
